purpose: Add an upward, cross-family MoE scaling point between Nemotron Super-120B-A12B and Nemotron Ultra-550B-A55B without returning to dense or small-MoE hosts.

scaling_position.reason: Provides a useful 22B-active cross-family point only after a four-or-more-GPU runtime can preserve Shohin's trainable post-MoE residual; it is not a two-H100 normal-partition shortcut.

admission.runtime_blocker: The official checkpoint is documented for TensorRT-LLM inference with tensor_parallel_size=4 on B200. The current Shohin treatment requires PyTorch module access and gradients through a small post-MoE residual; an inference engine result would not test that architecture.
requirements: Seal all active 35B validation artifacts and hashes before reclaiming its model snapshot.
Reclaim enough verified closed-work storage for the full repository plus conservative output headroom.
Verify the complete revision-pinned tree and ModelOpt runtime before any model load.
Qualify a four-or-more-GPU PyTorch/ModelOpt attachment path; TensorRT-LLM inference alone is insufficient.
Use the same model-owned draft to trained revision treatment and unchanged/self-refinement controls.
Use source-disjoint fixed identities and exact paired capability and retention scoring.
Require the 120B mechanics/result to determine whether two-H100 loading and the transfer attachment remain scientifically justified.

prohibitions: No download that violates durable quota headroom.
No inference-only result represented as Shohin improvement.
